title: gdpr.owner.alive
description: Answer to gdpr.owner.probe, emitted from the SAME module that consumes gdpr.erasure.requested — which is what makes it evidence that the erasure path is consumed rather than that a container is running. This module answers {owner: "billing", subject_types: ["account"], correlation_id}. The shape below is the action's contract (every owner emits it), not this emitter's subset.
